metadata.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer

problem.value: The rapid progress and diversity of transfer learning techniques in NLP make it difficult to compare different algorithms and understand existing methods.

evidence.quote: The rapid rate of progress and diversity of techniques in this burgeoning field can make it difficult to compare different algorithms, tease apart the effects of new contributions, and understand the space of existing methods for transfer learning.

contributions.value: Introducing a unified framework that converts all text-based language problems into a text-to-text format.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we explore the landscape of transfer learning techniques for NLP by introducing a unified framework that converts all text-based language problems into a text-to-text format.

contributions.value: Conducting a systematic study comparing pre-training objectives, architectures, unlabeled data sets, and transfer approaches.

evidence.quote: Our systematic study compares pre-training objectives, architectures, unlabeled data sets, transfer approaches, and other factors on dozens of language understanding tasks.

contributions.value: Releasing the Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus data set, pre-trained models, and code.

evidence.quote: By combining the insights from our exploration with scale and our new "Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus", we achieve state-of-the-art results on many benchmarks covering summarization, question answering, text classification, and more.

limitations.value: English-only pre-training failed to achieve state-of-the-art results on translation tasks.

evidence.quote: We were disappointed to find that English-only pre-training did not achieve state-of-the-art results on the translation tasks we studied.

future_work.value: Explore entirely different ways of leveraging unlabeled data instead of minor variations in objectives.

evidence.quote: Instead, it may be fortuitous to explore entirely different ways of leveraging unlabeled data.

future_work.value: Research methods to achieve stronger performance with cheaper models for transfer learning.

evidence.quote: As a result, we advocate for research on methods that achieve stronger performance with cheaper models so that transfer learning can be applied where it will have the most impact.

future_work.value: Investigate more efficient ways to provide general-purpose knowledge without requiring 1 trillion tokens of text.

evidence.quote: More concretely, it would be useful to be able to attain good fine-tuning performance without needing to train our models on 1 trillion tokens of text first.

future_work.value: Formulate a more rigorous notion of task similarity between pre-training and downstream tasks.

evidence.quote: It would be useful to formulate a more rigorous notion of the "similarity" between the pre-training and downstream tasks, so that we could make more principled choices about what source of unlabeled data to use.

future_work.value: Further investigate language-agnostic models to handle NLP tasks regardless of the language.

evidence.quote: To address these issues, we are interested in further investigating language-agnostic models, i.e. models that can perform a given NLP task with good performance regardless of the text's language.
